sentences.text: Holding brief of Mr. Manoj  Bhatt, Advocate.

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. G.S. Sandhu, Additional  Advocate General assisted by  Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Brief  Holder.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
This Application has been filed by the applicants for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 66 of 2025,
registered at Police Station Pulbhatta, District Udham Singh Nagar under Sections 420, 467, 468 and Section 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
According to the First Information Report dated 23.05.2025, the informant and the applicants were partners in the firm M/s Saawariya Foods.
The applicants prepared a fake partnership deed and illegally expelled the informant from the partnership.

3. Heard Mr. Mani Kumar, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. G.S. Sandhu, learned Additional Advocate General for the respondent.
4. Mr. Mani Kumar, Advocate, submitted that consent was given by the informant at the time of execution of new partnership deed.
The informant was paid the capital as described in the earlier partnership deed.
A notice was issued to the informant by the Office of the Registrar Firms, Societies and Chits, Udham Singh Nagar.
But, the informant did not appear before the said authority 5.

Mr. G.S. Sandhu, Additional Advocate General, has sought three weeks' time to file objection to Sachin Agrawal And Another ..... ... vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132270693/

sentences.text:
7. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicants Sachin Agrawal and Smt. Prema Agrawal, they shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and they shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
8. List on 16.07.2025 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.

__ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Date:10.06.2025 Shiv/
